question.worked_solution:
Solving $x-y+2z=0$ for $y,$ we get $y=x+2z.$ Therefore, any vector from $\text{Im}(T)$ can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ x+2z \\ z\end{aligned}]=x{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{1}}+z{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

This means that $\text{Im}(T)=\text{Span}\{{v}_{1},{v}_{2}\}.$ Therefore, $\text{rank}(T)=2.$ 

Finally, according the rank-nullity theorem, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{nullity}(T) & =3-\text{rank}(T) \\  & =3-2 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
